survey: A folding camp chair in three-quarter view from slightly above, standing on a pale floor in front of a red wall. A metal tube frame forms the backrest: two uprights and a top rail holding a green panel with a yellow emblem. The uprights run down into the back edge of a thin green seat. Under the seat, each side has an X-shaped pair of crossed tubes joined at a pivot. Their feet are tied by floor stretchers at the front and back, with round foot caps. The seat is seen slightly from above as a thin shape. The floor-level frame is seen more from above as a clear parallelogram, which fits a camera a little above seat height. The front and back stretchers and the seat rails slope toward a common vanishing direction. The backrest uprights are nearly vertical and parallel. All four foot caps sit on the floor plane, and the shadow falls on that plane. The tube ends and caps are small ellipses that match the view. The whole object was rendered from one 3D camera, and nothing contradicts it.
